transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello! How is your eye doing since your surgery?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I've made a note to go into that. Would you mind if I first ask about your eye redness? Is your eye currently red?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, my eye is feeling fine overall and I don't have any eye redness.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I've made a note to go into that. Now, I'd like to ask about eye pain. Is your eye currently painful?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I don't have any eye pain. My recovery has been smooth.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I've made a note to go into that. Now, I'd like to ask about your vision. Has your vision improved as you expected since the surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, my vision has improved as expected, and my eye is feeling fine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I've made a note to go into that. Now, I'd like to ask about floaters. Have you noticed any floaters since the surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I haven't noticed any floaters. My recovery has been smooth.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I've made a note to go into that. Now, I'd like to ask about flashing lights. Have you noticed any flashing lights since the surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I haven't noticed any flashing lights. My eye is feeling fine overall.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
I've made a note to go into that. It sounds like your recovery is going well so far. Let me summarize what we've discussed:

You mentioned your overall eye recovery is fine, and you don't have any eye redness or eye pain. Your vision has also improved as expected since the surgery. You haven't noticed any floaters or flashing lights. Is this summary correct?

verdict.label: pass
verdict.reasoning: The agent explicitly asked the top-level question for eye redness: "Is your eye currently red?" and did not bundle it with other questions. The patient clearly answered the question.
